Weights are const float (SeparationWeight=2.0, UnitAvoidanceWeight=1.0, ObstacleAvoidanceWeight=1.5, CohesionWeight=0.15, FlowWeight=1.0). Stacked-pair branch (distSq < 1e-6) uses a deterministic CompareEntities tie-break (Index then Version) so two units at identical positions still receive non-zero opposite-direction pushes. Obstacle-avoidance samples NavCostField.Cost at the cell one ObstacleLookAhead (2.0m) along the flow direction; impassable -> push backwards. Final vector normalized to XZ plane; HasValue=0 when accumulator is essentially zero (falls through to FlowDesiredDir or NavMesh in MovementSystem). emits NavPathRequest via ECB for every released entry (duplicates included, since the pathfinder solves identical inputs identically); leftover entries carried to next tick; static EnqueueRequest helper for managed callers with M3 direct-attach fallback when the singleton isn't bootstrapped yet); layer mask = intersection across members so only layers admissible by EVERYONE appear; reads TraversalProfileBlob.Profiles by 'ref var prof' per EA0001 then copies primitives into locals); FormationLeaderNavSystem ([UpdateAfter(FlowFollowSystem)] [UpdateBefore(SteeringSystem)]; Burst IJobEntity parallel-for over units with FormationFlowFollower+FlowDesiredDir+LocalTransform; per-unit reads leader transform + leader BattalionLeader fields via ComponentLookup, computes slot world position via leader.FormationRot.mul(local offset from cols*spacing), converts slot+unit to integer cells, runs integer Bresenham LOS (mirror of FormationFollowJob's BresenhamLOS) against NavCostField.Cost with maxSteps=dx+dz+1 bound -- LOS clear -> writes normalized slot direction into FlowDesiredDir; LOS blocked -> leaves the existing flow alone so the leader's flow carries the unit through obstacles; never calls Physics.Raycast / NavMesh / Mathf / UnityEngine.Random). UnitNavProfileAttachSystem extended with a _missingFollowerQuery pass that attaches FormationFlowFollower{LeaderEntity, SlotIndex = memberData.Row*leader.Columns + memberData.Column, DesiredSpacing = max(0.25, leader.Spacing*0.5)} to every UnitTag+BattalionMemberData entity without one -- uses the M5 catch-all attach pattern so we don't touch every BattalionFactory member spawn path. MoveCommandHelper.EmitNavPathRequest migrated to call NavRequestSchedulerSystem.EnqueueRequest(em, unit, startCell, goalCell, profileHash:0, priority:PendingNavRequest.PriorityUser, generation:portalGeneration) instead of attaching NavPathRequest directly; the scheduler helper falls back to direct-attach when the queue singleton hasn't bootstrapped (first-frame race). M3's MaxRequestsPerTick=8 literal on AbstractPathfinderSystem is INTENTIONALLY LEFT in place -- the M6 scheduler caps unique (goal, profile) classes per tick to 16 BEFORE the pathfinder runs, then the pathfinder processes its 8 per tick from whatever the scheduler emitted (effectively the system-level rate-limit chain is min(16 scheduler-released, 8 pathfinder-processed)). The CSR-surgery R-A polish (architecture's optional M6 stretch goal) is DEFERRED per the task body's explicit 'OPTIONAL stretch goal for M6; if time-bound, leave as // M7 TODO' instruction; the existing IncrementalPortalRebuildSystem full-rebuild path stays.
